title: True Wio
description: The is an elemental mod by your truly unfits
body:
This Plugin Adds Cores That Give You The Ability To Control Air, Water, and Fire. 

● Air: Ability 1(Dash): A Quick Dash, Ability 2(Tornado): Launches the Opponent In The Air,
Passive: You take no fall damage.

● Water: Ability 1(Wave): Knocks all Opponents Away, Ability 2(Rain): Rain That does tick damage.
Passive: Infinite Water Breathing/Dolphins Grace

● Fire: Ability 1(FireBall) Shoots a ball of fire to your Opponent, Ability 2(Supernova) A massive Explosion The Destorys Land and Leaves Fire In The Remains.
Passive: Infinite Fire Resistance
